Hi Sanjay - thanks for the agenda. Heads-up: US daylight saving starts on Sun, Mar 8 (we spring forward). That means 9:00 AM PST on Wed Mar 10 would actually be 9:00 AM PDT (UTC-7) - the calendar client will usually handle it, but cross-region invites sometimes display local time incorrectly for APAC participants.

To avoid any confusion for Liam and the rest of your APAC team, can we either:
- Move to Wed Mar 10 at 10:00 AM PDT / Thu Mar 11 05:00 AM NZDT (if that's workable), or
- Shift to Thu Mar 11 at 1:00 PM PDT / Fri Mar 12 10:00 AM NZDT for a more reasonable hour for NZ.

Rishi and Priya - can you confirm bandwidth for both slots? Sanjay - if you prefer, we can keep Wed but I'll send an explicit updated invite with both UTC times and an .ics file set to UTC to prevent client conversions.

Cheers,
